subject: general
question: Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma was an Indian Classical Dancer of _________ dance form.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Mohiniyattam__.**

__***Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalamandalam Kallyanikutty Amma **was an epoch-making **Mohiniyattam danseuse** from Kerala in southern India.
 
• **Mohiniyattam is a classical Indian dance**, which by definition traces its repertoire to the foundational text **Natya Shastra.**
 
• The** Natya Shastra** text is attributed to the ancient scholar **Bharata Muni**. 
 
• Its first complete compilation is dated to between** 200 BCE and 200 CE**, but estimates vary **between 500 BCE and 500 CE.**

• **Sattriya*** or ***Sattriya Nritya*** is a major** ****Indian classical dance.**
 
• **Odissi** also **mention as Orissa in old literature** is a major** old Indian classical dance** that **originated in the Hindu temples of Odisha.**
 
• **Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance**. It is the classical dance form of **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The origin of **Kathak is traditionally assigned** to the traveling bards in **ancient northern India.**
